title: UAE GovTrust Scope Filtering Gains and Routing Failures in Bilingual Public Service Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2610.32608v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Public-service queries can mention several locations while only one controls the requested service. We study this distinction in UAE GovTrust, a controlled English-Arabic retrieval diagnostic comprising 22 authored service summaries and 50 scenarios with 110 query variants. Twelve methods separate lexical and dense ranking, rank fusion, scope filtering, a multilingual cross-encoder, and direct service lookup. On 72 matched answerable queries with bilingual evidence, role-filtered reciprocal rank fusion retrieves a relevant first result for 69 queries (95.8%), versus 47 (65.3%) for unfiltered fusion; filtered dense retrieval and direct lookup each achieve 68 (94.4%). With English-only evidence, excluding zero-score lexical candidates raises filtered fusion from 52 to 64 correct first hits. translated_title: 阿联酋 GovTrust：双语公共服务检索中的范围过滤收益与路由失败
translated_abstract: 公共服务查询可能同时提及多个地点，而其中只有一个地点负责所请求的服务。我们在 UAE GovTrust 中研究这一区别，这是一个受控的英语-阿拉伯语检索诊断集，包含 22 篇人工撰写的服务摘要，以及 50 个场景下的 110 个查询变体。研究对比了十二种方法，涵盖词法与稠密排序、排名融合、范围过滤、多语言交叉编码器以及直接服务查找。在 72 个带有双语证据的可匹配可回答查询上，采用角色过滤的倒数排名融合方法为 69 个查询（95.8%）检索到相关的首条结果，而未过滤的融合仅为 47 个（65.3%）；过滤后的稠密检索和直接查找各达到 68 个（94.4%）。在仅有英语证据的情况下，排除零分词法候选使过滤融合的正确首条命中数从 52 提升到 64。然而，保持不变的路由器在 168 次审计后扰动（涵盖改述、无关事实等）中，仅正确选择操作和范围 2 次（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文提出双语公共服务检索诊断集 UAE GovTrust，证明基于角色范围过滤可将首条结果相关率从 65.3% 大幅提升至 95.8%，但现有路由器在扰动场景下几乎完全失效（168 次扰动中仅 2 次正确）。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces UAE GovTrust, a controlled English-Arabic public-service retrieval diagnostic, showing that role-based scope filtering boosts first-hit relevance from 65.3% to 95.8%, while the routing module nearly collapses under perturbations (only 2 of 168 correct).
